prompt: Develop this original travel note into an engaging paragraph without adding landmarks: 'A ferry crossing at dawn. Grey water. Warm bread in a paper bag. A child counting buoys. The far shore becomes distinct very slowly.' Aim for about 80 words.
text: At dawn, the ferry carried us across grey water, its steady hum filling the pauses between a child’s calls as they counted buoys. I held a paper bag of warm bread against my lap, folding back the top to tear off a piece. Each buoy slipped behind us before the next came into view. Ahead, the far shore became distinct so slowly that I kept looking away and back again, trying to catch the moment when a blur became land.
